coverage_note: Best-effort census of restaurants in Denton, TX, built from 128 Google Maps-backed place searches (by cuisine, by neighborhood, by ZIP, and by name) plus structured place details for every record. It is not a guaranteed exhaustive registry: TripAdvisor lists roughly 400 restaurants in Denton and MenuPix lists 585, so this census of 288 likely covers about half to two-thirds of all food-serving establishments. Food trucks, campus dining concepts, and very new or very small venues are the most likely to be missing, because many of them have no place record. Permanently or temporarily closed places and places outside Denton city limits were excluded. Real restaurants in this file are prospects for CommonTable outreach; they are NOT partners and nothing here is orderable.
